data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: scripts/ml_data_collector.py (CLI patterns)
- Read: scripts/ml_file_prediction.py (training CLI example)
- Read: cortical/spark/git_trainer.py (once implemented)

## Implementation
Create scripts/train_spark_from_git.py:
1. CLI with argparse for configuration
2. Commands: train, evaluate, stats
3. Options: --branches, --half-life, --min-weight, --output
4. Integration with GitHistoryTrainer
5. Progress reporting during training

## Guardrails
- DO: Follow existing script patterns in scripts/
- DO: Add --dry-run for testing
- DO: Report memory usage and commit counts
- DO: Save model to .git-ml/spark_model/ by default
- DO NOT: Require external dependencies
- DO NOT: Block on slow operations without progress
- EXPLORE: Whether to support incremental training
- EXPLORE: Integration with existing ml_data_collector hooks

## Success Criteria
- Can train model from scratch on current repo
- Provides useful statistics (commits, weights, vocab size)
- Model can be saved and loaded
- --help shows all options clearly
data.title: Create training CLI script for SparkSLM git training
